summary: FAIL. The round-3 repairs are real: 16 of my 17 earlier findings are re-verified CLOSED_VERIFIED, each reproduced on its original commit and shown fixed on 53f5d176. F-DG0-115 (High, mandatory) stays OPEN. checkWriteOnce uses 'git log --diff-filter=MDT' without merge diffs, so a merge commit can rewrite committed reviewer artefacts undetected. A genuine FAIL verification of a High mandatory finding was forged into a closure, and the gate passed in current and historical mode and in the pipeline (repro-r4 tests 10-12). New Low findings: F-DG0-118 (skip-worktree hides local tampering), F-DG0-119 (the output binding holds end-of-window bytes at attempted paths; the docs overstate it), F-DG0-120 (runner auto-commit pathspec globbing and masked failures), F-DG0-121 (gate record content not bound to the auditor run). The write guard, candidate identity (mode, symlinks, CRLF, fileMode), CI configuration, argument validation and secrets hygiene all pass.
